uiEvidenceClassifications.executable: A browser/UI path creates or verifies the scenario model through public UI interactions and emits comparable artifacts.
uiEvidenceClassifications.validated-replay: A deterministic replay or bridge test validates UI/Cmd+K mapping against the scenario fixture, but does not prove browser-authored exact input.
uiEvidenceClassifications.traceability-only: The scenario maps intended UI/Cmd+K affordances to semantic outputs without executing or replaying them.
uiEvidenceClassifications.missing: No UI evidence exists yet for this scenario.
